create_multidictionary: create a MultiDictionary instance to store multiple hashable values per key with automatic deduplication
add_key_value_pairs: add key-value pairs to a MultiDictionary using the add method to append values to existing keys
retrieve_values_by_key: retrieve the set of deduplicated values for a given key using bracket notation on the MultiDictionary
iterate_multidictionary: iterate over all keys in the MultiDictionary using a for loop or the keys method
inspect_multidictionary_contents: inspect all key-value pairs in the MultiDictionary using the items method or repr for formatted output
